import openpyxl, os
from datetime import time, datetime
wb=openpyxl.load_workbook(os.environ['IN_XLSX'])
ws=wb.active
times=[ws.cell(1,c).value for c in range(2,14)]
print('times',times)
lo=time(4,0); hi=time(14,0)
cols=[c for c in range(2,14) if lo<=ws.cell(1,c).value<=hi]
print('cols',cols)
dlo=datetime(2024,1,5); dhi=datetime(2024,1,8)
total=0
for r in range(2,17):
    d=ws.cell(r,1).value
    if d and dlo<=d<=dhi:
        for c in cols:
            v=ws.cell(r,c).value
            if isinstance(v,(int,float)):
                total+=v
print('total',total)
